The crowd and anger are real; the population-wide conclusion is not established by a self-selected funeral/political crowd. No operator, state-control or IRGC-control inference follows. Expanded July 8–August 2 pattern review records six distinct qualifying WOL-native information events. The pattern is not that Lim's shipping data are generally false: much of the traffic, insurance and damage substrate is real. The recurring failure is converting that substrate into unsupported binary-control/causal conclusions, plus two hard factual failures: the self-contradictory 'not reopened for a single day' claim and a 4000-fold insurance multiplier that is arithmetically about 27–40-fold using his own percentages. The deterministic Bullshitter award must be derived from the six events rather than manually assigned. A September 25 correction-awareness/intent follow-up found a stronger internal inconsistency but did not establish a public repeat-after-correction or intent finding: the July 10 commentary says the war failed to reopen Hormuz 'for a single day' while the same article later says the June settlement 'briefly cracked the Strait open,' and later commentary continued categorical open/closed framing. No recoverable public receipt was found showing Lim acknowledging an external correction and then knowingly repeating the corrected proposition. WOL therefore preserves the existing six incidents and Bullshitter award without promoting REPEAT_AFTER_CORRECTION, evidentiary-evasion, or deliberate-deception language.

A bounded July 17–August 15 review now records six distinct qualifying MeidasTouch publication events. The recurring pattern preserves a severe factual substrate—Iranian vessel attacks, genuine U.S. munitions depletion, extensive base damage and Bahrain logistics disruption—while repeatedly converting that substrate into unsupported absolutes such as seven tankers destroyed, zero Patriot/THAAD inventory, the U.S. out of all weapons, and essentially all regional U.S. bases destroyed/obliterated. Repeated publications count separately; multiple atomic propositions inside one episode count once. The deterministic Bullshitter award must be derived rather than manually assigned. The older July 12 broad-base-destruction discovery remains separately queued for upstream canonical atomization and is not needed to earn the source-behavior award. Propagation-only sweep on September 25 found broad RSS/podcast/transcript redistribution of the scored episodes through Apple/iHeart and transcript/index services, but no clean independent downstream account adoption of the six scored propositions survived the directional-receipt standard.
